decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from axios/axios PR #11096, merged 2026-08-13, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Core hard-coded divergent HTTP method lists (defaults.headers lacked options/purge/link/unlink slots; dispatch header cleanup used another inline list), and the node HTTP adapter threw bare TypeError for an invalid httpVersion and for an invalid address produced by a custom lookup — the latter from inside the DNS callback where nothing catches it, crashing the process instead of rejecting. The fix (5 files, system complexity) introduces the shared frozen lib/core/methodList.js, rewires defaults/index.js, core/Axios.js cleanup and core/mergeConfig.js onto it, and converts the adapter errors to AxiosError with ERR_BAD_OPTION_VALUE, wrapping the lookup address-entry construction so the error reaches the request's rejection path. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (2d2a21af) to lib/ + index.js + package.json + LICENSE. axios's runtime deps come from the per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:axios-11096 (sandbox/Dockerfile.axios-11096: node-ts + npm install --omit=dev of the repo's package.json, with /node_modules symlinked at the filesystem root because ESM imports resolve via the node_modules ancestor walk, not NODE_PATH; build with the TASK REPO as docker context — .dockerignore excludes tasks/). Hidden tests run node --test with loopback node:http servers (sandbox network-off keeps loopback): 4 fail_to_pass, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — full per-method default header slots, method-scoped OPTIONS headers actually applied, httpVersion and lookup errors as AxiosError with the ERR_BAD_OPTION_VALUE code (code constants are public API; no message-text assertions); 4 pass_to_pass guards pin basic GET/POST, existing header slots, and error-status rejection shape.
